title: polypodium suboligolepidum
intro: Polypodium suboligolepidum, commonly known as the Chinese Polypody, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium suboligolepidum include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce inflammation and oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
